ca-rtr-launch.so_what: Check provider readiness for the scheduled RTR launch, not assumed availability.

eu-psr-position.so_what: Track the EU legislative process; this milestone is not an application date.

eu-psd3-position.so_what: Track PSD3 separately from PSR; do not treat this vote as a go-live date.

nz-commercial-cards.so_what: Lower regulated commercial-card interchange is coming; confirm what your acquirer passes through.

pix-dict-default.so_what: Check refund integrations that rely on implicit monitoring defaults.

emv-3ds24.so_what: Watch the 3DS draft; do not schedule a mandatory migration on this source alone.

au-network-disclosure.so_what: Use the new scheme-fee disclosures to challenge unexplained line items.

au-acquirer-disclosure.so_what: Compare published acquirer fees with your own card mix and contract.

uk-pricing-governance.so_what: Ask for evidence behind relevant UK scheme-fee decisions, not a savings promise.

ca-eu-interlink.so_what: Keep the proposed connection on your roadmap, not your live-route inventory.

au-surcharging.so_what: Recheck checkout pricing: designated card-network surcharge rules changed.

au-domestic-interchange.so_what: Lower domestic interchange caps make pass-through worth checking; net merchant savings depend on your terms.

au-net-compensation.so_what: Check issuer incentives against the amended compensation rules.

au-pass-through.so_what: Ask your acquirer how the interchange reduction reached your statement.

au-foreign-cards.so_what: Review foreign-card pricing before the new caps apply.

au-statements.so_what: Make sure the new statement detail reaches your reconciliation process.

au-scheme-roadmap.so_what: Watch for the fee roadmap; it is not itself a price cap.

ach-same-day-limit.so_what: Check whether the larger Same Day ACH limit changes your payout routing.

ach-availability.so_what: Check payout promises against the receiving bank’s 9am availability duty.

ach-iat.so_what: Review how your ACH provider classifies international entries.

ach-availability-exceptions.so_what: Ask your bank which availability exceptions affect your credits.

ach-iat-date-of-birth.so_what: Check how your IAT integration will handle the optional date-of-birth field.

ach-iat-contacts.so_what: Confirm ownership of IAT contact registration with your ACH provider.

uk-fee-transparency.so_what: Prepare to reconcile fee triggers with acquiring invoices.

uk-fee-logic-extension.so_what: Some fee logic arrives later; acquirers can request it during the extension.

uk-safeguarding.so_what: Check how your provider reconciles and safeguards customer funds.

uk-rtgs-delay.so_what: Remove the superseded November release from your implementation plan.

pix-dict-rc.so_what: Review recovery API changes before implementation; a candidate release is not a deadline.

emv-3ds-extensions.so_what: Ask your 3DS provider whether its product qualifies for the extension.

emv-agentic-draft.so_what: Separate consumer-intent design work from deployed network requirements.

us-regii-watch.so_what: Monitor the official docket; do not price a new debit cap from this preview.
